purpose: Machine-readable record of the environment FCVE was actually validated on, and what a fresh reconstruction must have. Read by scripts/doctor.sh and scripts/setup.sh. 'validated' means observed to work here; nothing is claimed for other machines.

validated_environment.note: Only this environment has been validated. Other Macs, other macOS versions and Linux are untested; the doctor reports a difference as WARN (unvalidated), not as an error.

python3.role: FCVE engine and tests (standard library only)

sample.role: stack sample of a stalled export (macOS only)

lake.role: Lean build tool (comes with the toolchain)

tectonic.role: compiles FCVE reports (not needed for audit.sh)

lean.note: Mathlib revisions are per target project (its lake-manifest.json), not global. A toolchain tag must match the target's lean-toolchain exactly; lean4export is built per tag.

tool_patches.policy: Patched tools are optional and always disclosed. A verdict from them must say PATCHED, name the patch hashes below, and cite the validation (equivalence test, regression, negative control). Upstream PRs: leanprover/lean4export#52, ammkrn/nanoda_lib#36 (open, not merged).

measured_requirements.note: Measured on the validated Mac mini, single runs. Approximate, not universal constants.

disk_gib.explanation: Below hard_floor_free the export guard aborts and the audit reports UNRESOLVED (not a failure of the theorem).

measured_requirements.ram_gib_observed: an unpatched export of a huge-literal proof reached ~9 GB RSS while stalling; normal audits are far lower

runtime_seconds_observed.axiom_row_dominated_by: importing Mathlib (~2-3 min per lake env lean invocation)

verdict_semantics.PASS: the check ran and its conditions hold
verdict_semantics.FAIL: the check ran and the proof/evidence was rejected
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED: the check could not complete (stall, disk guard); no verdict on the proof
verdict_semantics.TOOL_ERROR: the tool never ran properly; no verdict on the proof
verdict_semantics.UNRESOLVED: not evaluated or not evaluable (e.g. needs the web); never a pass
verdict_semantics.PARTIAL: passes with a stated weaker basis (e.g. reused build cache, patched tools)
verdict_semantics.NEEDS HUMAN: requires a named human's judgment (semantic correspondence)
verdict_semantics.PROVISIONAL: no active failure, but rows remain unresolved; the ceiling of audit.sh
verdict_semantics.TRUSTED: never produced automatically; requires the human and web rows too
